faq.answer_text: The CRCST examination contains a total of 150 questions distributed across seven distinct content domains covering sterile processing practices, equipment management, and departmental procedures for candidates.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: Candidates are given a total duration of exactly 180 minutes to complete all questions on the professional examination administered by the Healthcare Sterile Processing Association.

The official certification examination is administered, maintained, and fully managed directly by the Healthcare Sterile Processing Association for individuals pursuing official central service technician professional certification credentials.

The exam covers seven domains with varying weights: departmental considerations, cleaning and decontamination, preparation and packaging, sterilization processes, sterile storage and transport, patient care equipment, and professional development.

editorial.overview: The CRCST (Certified Registered Central Service Technician) examination evaluates knowledge across seven distinct content domains, including departmental considerations, cleaning, decontamination, sterilization processes, and inventory management. The Healthcare Sterile Processing Association (HSPA) administers this 180-minute evaluation to ensure candidates possess the competencies required for professional central service technician roles across healthcare facilities.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the official content outline from the Healthcare Sterile Processing Association (HSPA) to fully understand the specific weight percentages across all seven domains. Focus your study time carefully on high-weight domains such as cleaning, preparation, packaging, and sterilization to maximize your overall score on the test and ensure proper readiness.
editorial.who_should_take: Candidates seeking professional credentialing as central service technicians. This credential validates knowledge in sterile processing, decontamination, and sterile storage within modern healthcare facilities for aspiring professionals.
